issue.title: UTable sort icon doesn't rotate when clicking a column header
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

Clicking a sortable column header on `UTable` sorts the rows correctly, but the little chevron icon next to the header label never rotates to show ascending vs descending. It stays pointing down no matter the sort direction.

### Expected behavior

The icon should flip depending on sort direction, like it used to in 1.2.x.
issue.author: devonhall

similar.title: Table sort icon stuck pointing down after clicking header
similar.body: Same as above, the chevron on the sortable column header never rotates when toggling sort direction on UTable.
